Chips must use aria-pressed for toggle state

SR-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ChipBar component that renders a row of filter chips. Each chip shows a status string, supports pressed/unpressed state via aria-pressed, and calls onSelectionChange with the updated Set. Include the CSS file with the component.
SR-01.output:
The `ChipBar` component is written at `src/components/ChipBar/ChipBar.tsx` with its colocated `ChipBar.css`. Key details:

- `role="group"` container with `aria-label` for accessible grouping
- Each chip is a `<button>` with `aria-pressed` (boolean) reflecting selection state
- Click toggles membership in the `Set<Status>` and calls `onSelectionChange` with the new set
- CSS uses `--shelf-chip-*` component-tier tokens, `appearance: none`, transitions only on `background-color`/`color`/`border-color` (mapped through opacity/transform-safe properties)
